test_tz_localize_pushes_out_of_bounds: test Timestamp.tz_localize raises OutOfBoundsDatetime when timezone conversion exceeds Timestamp.min or Timestamp.max bounds
test_tz_localize_ambiguous_bool: test Timestamp.tz_localize accepts bool ambiguous parameter for ambiguous DST transition times with pytz dateutil and zoneinfo
test_tz_localize_ambiguous: test Timestamp.tz_localize raises ValueError for ambiguous times and rejects invalid ambiguous parameter values
test_tz_localize_nonexistent: test Timestamp.tz_localize raises ValueError for nonexistent DST gap times and supports nonexistent='NaT' handling
test_tz_localize_nonexistent_shift: test Timestamp.tz_localize supports nonexistent='shift_forward' and 'shift_backward' to adjust nonexistent DST gap times
